subject.title: fix(slack): preserve channel ID case in normalizeSlackMessagingTarget

question: Should Slack `messaging.normalizeTarget` become case-preserved globally, or should case preservation be limited to delivery/action API IDs while matching keeps lower-case canonical aliases?
rationale: Both open candidate PRs address the same Slack bug, but this PR changes a broader normalizer contract that generic binding and session paths currently consume exactly.

options.title: Preserve aliases before broad merge
options.body: Keep this PR's case-preserved API target behavior only if the lower-case matching/account-binding/session aliases remain explicitly covered before merge.

options.title: Prefer the narrower fix
options.body: Use the delivery/session-target approach from the sibling PR if maintainers want `normalizeTarget` to remain a lower-case comparison key.

options.title: Accept the contract change
options.body: Maintainers can knowingly accept the broad normalizer change if existing lower-case Slack aliases are not considered upgrade-sensitive.

recommendation.title: Preserve aliases before broad merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's case-preserved API target behavior only if the lower-case matching/account-binding/session aliases remain explicitly covered before merge.
